description: EMCA earthquake catalogue of Central Asia (GFZ Data Services) is an open data portal listed in EMCA earthquake catalogue of Central Asia (GFZ Data Services), an open data portal, published or maintained by GFZ German Research Centre for Geosciences (Earthquake Model Central Asia). The Earthquake Model Central Asia (EMCA) catalogue is a unified earthquake catalogue for Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Uzbekistan and Turkmenistan, made for regional seismic hazard assessment under the Global Earthquake Model programme and coordinated by GFZ. Coverage: Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Uzbekistan and Turkmenistan. The GFZ page states that the catalogue holds 33,620 earthquakes with time, location and magnitude on the MLH (surface-wave) scale, from 1.5 to 8.3, and that it is free for scientific use. GFZ also lists derived products for the region (a landslide catalogue, exposure models, a seismic source model and building data). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this country. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-gfz-emca-earthquake-catalogue-of-central-asia.
